title: centaurea micranthos subsp. kemulariae
intro: Centaurea micranthos subsp. kemulariae, commonly known as a type of thistle, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, which provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties. These compounds also exhibit potential in treating various health conditions, including digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
